decision.reason: [ev-fb8b2703ee0d] is one changelog line saying only "Wait for Subscription resources to reach AtLatestKnown", plus a pointer to PR #21425. It doesn't name the API group or kind of "Subscription". It also doesn't say which mechanism does the waiting (a health check or sync), so we can't tell which environments are exposed. Finally, it doesn't say what the old behaviour was or what happens to an operator who does nothing, such as a change in health status or sync timing. The PR or the health-check diff is needed to decide applicability and consequence.
